import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXNODES = 1000;
    static final int MAXEDGES = 2000000;
    static final int INF_DIST = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, rev;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] adj = new List[MAXNODES];
    static int S, T, N, T_limit;
    static int[][] dist_map = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] depth_map = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] node_idx = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] sink_idx = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid_1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid_2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adj[u].add(new Edge(v, cap, adj[v].size()));
        adj[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, adj[u].size() - 1));
    }

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy, boolean build) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy});
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist_map[i], INF_DIST);
        }
        dist_map[sx][sy] = 0;
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            
            if (build && sink_idx[x][y] != 0 && dist_map[x][y] <= T_limit && dist_map[x][y] <= depth_map[x][y]) {
                connect(node_idx[x][y], sink_idx[x][y], INF_DIST);
            }
            
            if (dist_map[x][y] > T_limit || dist_map[x][y] >= depth_map[x][y]) continue;
            
            if (node_idx[x][y] == 3 && sink_idx[x][y] == 9) {
                System.out.println(dist_map[x][y]);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 1 && nx <= N && ny >= 1 && ny <= N && 
                    Character.isDigit(grid_1[nx][ny]) && dist_map[nx][ny] == INF_DIST) {
                    dist_map[nx][ny] = dist_map[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] level = new int[MAXNODES];
    
    static boolean build_level() {
        Arrays.fill(level, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(S);
        level[S] = 1;
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                if (level[e.to] == 0 && e.cap > 0) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                    if (e.to == T) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == T) return flow;
        for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.cap -= pushed;
                    adj[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        T_limit = sc.nextInt();
        N = n;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid_1[i][j+1] = s.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                grid_2[i][j+1] = s.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(depth_map[i], INF_DIST);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid_1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs(i, j, false);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(dist_map[i], 0, depth_map[i], 0, MAXN);
        }
        
        int node_count = 1;
        S = 0;
        T = 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXNODES; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (grid_1[i][j] > '0' && grid_1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    node_idx[i][j] = ++node_count;
                    connect(S, node_idx[i][j], grid_1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (grid_2[i][j] > '0' && grid_2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    sink_idx[i][j] = ++node_count;
                    connect(sink_idx[i][j], T, grid_2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (node_idx[i][j] != 0) {
                    bfs(i, j, true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int max_flow = 0;
        while (build_level()) {
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(S, INF_DIST);
                if (pushed <= 0) break;
                max_flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow);
        sc.close();
    }
}
